settings.comment_maxWaitForLoad: Content-heavy detail pages (e.g. a thesis) can exceed Lighthouse's default 45s load cap under simulated mobile throttling; an incomplete gather then reports present metadata (meta-description) as missing. 60s lets the audit complete and reflect reality. Real mobile perf is still tracked by the categories:performance warn assertion.

assertMatrix.comment: All audited URLs. SEO + canonical live in the auth-excluding entry below: noindex utility pages (e.g. /auth/login) legitimately fail is-crawlable and must not be held to a public-SEO score.
Indexable content pages only — everything except /auth/* (login/signup are noindex by design, so a public-SEO threshold and canonical assertion are false signals there).
